messages.subject: Dynamic Factor Models

Karen Fiorella

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Dynamic Factor Models
parts:
sorry, we cannot do factor models when the factors are unknown. the
reason is that the model will contain products of normals, not just
sums.

H
